description: Get everything needed to fill a Visamundi visa application for one visa product: accepted purposes and nationalities, the JSON Schema of `values` and `travelers`, the visa questionnaire, date and passport-validity constraints, arrival-card and insurance options, and the estimated price. Call after get_visa, before save_application.

language.description: Language of labels and questions (default en).

visaId.description: Visa product ID, as returned by list_visas / get_visa.

name: get_application_form
